name: portable-workflow
notes: Engine-agnostic. Do not add API-locked predicates. Do not copy this file into the skill or into an agent workspace. Pack meta may add band_a_extra (e.g. prior_sensitivity_refit) or band_a_skip (A1 omits constraint_ok: no positive scale).

band_a.need: both a 50% typical interval and a 94% range (HDI)
measured rank-normalized split R-hat ≤ 1.01 (draws, diagnostics JSON, or stated maximum; not the characters 1.01 alone)
if divergences exist, refuse to interpret; if none, say so
posterior predictives from the same likelihood used for inference, not a numpy rewrite
positive scales via a constrained declaration, a positive family, or an explicit Jacobian

band_b.need: nominal HDI contains each listed true parameter
